title: Deployments: Redesigned dashboard and environment cards
description: The Bitbucket Deployments page has a new look and feel to help you track your software across environments more efficiently. We’ve updated the layout to a three-column view: Test, Staging, and Production, so you can see the status of your environments at a glance. Each environment now features a redesigned card that surfaces essential details like build numbers, commit messages, and the person who authored the commit.
